title: People working at a shared project table
visual_facts: Several people sit and stand around a large central worktable in a bright room.
The table is covered with small electronic parts, hand tools, wires, papers, and clear plastic bags.
A person near the center holds a long narrow object over a cardboard construction on the table.
Another cardboard structure sits near the front edge of the table.
Tall windows line the left side of the room, and rows of ceiling lights are visible overhead.
Additional tables and people are visible in the background.
spatial_relations: The people are gathered around the central worktable.
Windows run along the left wall, with the worktables extending into the room.
uncertainties: The specific project and purpose of the small objects are not identifiable.
No readable signs identify this room.
